digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Thursday, November 12, with six meetings, two protected work blocks, one 11:30 AM conflict, nine candidate carry-overs, and nine items marked urgent. First, close Amazon Connect’s last office-level issue while setting Wave 2 and Wave 3 ownership; then settle the Product/EPMO communication gap and the SMS grooming plan, including the unresolved Sprint 23 versus Sprint 25 sequence. Use the BD and Maria portfolio conversations to force today’s taskset, VAWA, and Production Compliance decisions, and protect the 3:00 PM preparation block before the weekly meeting. The repository state snapshot is dated November 6, so the publication workflow will refresh completion and hidden state before pruning carry-over items.

items.label: Close the Amazon Connect rollout follow-through
items.detail: All 12 branch offices are now live. Validate Angie’s Dallas call routing after the forward was removed, then assign owners for the Wave 2 virtual-queue Omni flows, the multi-tab fix and FAQ, the access-catalog decision, and classification of the 400 additional users across later waves.

items.label: Close the Product handoff and communication gap
items.detail: Leadership confirmed the Product communication plan needs work, including an unannounced Craft rollout and changed ownership for writing IT stories. Set the EPMO intake, initiation, prioritization, and escalation expectations before the new process is rolled out.

items.label: Route Maribel’s intake-ownership access request correctly
items.detail: The request is still appearing as a CoE project intake. Confirm the IT or HALO owner and close the routing gap so access work stops cycling through the project portfolio.

items.label: Close the remaining meeting and coverage follow-ups
items.detail: Confirm yesterday’s rollout, Product, portfolio, and leadership overlaps did not leave an unowned action. Identify the IT biweekly occurrence Mar asked to move and confirm the replacement time.

items.label: Complete the overdue EPMO Asana pain-points poll
items.detail: Submit the overdue poll so the team’s workflow friction is represented in the next EPMO discussion.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS finding
items.detail: The alert identifies a publicly accessible table with Row-Level Security disabled. Confirm whether it is new or recurring and assign remediation immediately.

items.label: Review and sign the two AI policy documents
items.detail: Rippling is still waiting on the AI Tool Development Policy and AI Tools Quick Reference Guide, both FRAP No. 002. Complete both signatures in one pass.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: This has remained open since October 23. Finish the short follow-up separately from the Module 4 pre-work.

items.label: Schedule the LeadUp Module 4 pre-work
items.detail: The Leading with Strategy pre-work is due November 17. Reserve a completion window before Friday’s management and pipeline stack.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - BD Portfolio Review and Sara 1:1
items.detail: Use the portfolio review to isolate risks, blockers, and new intake decisions, then carry only the decisions that need leadership input into the Sara 1:1.

items.label: 11:30 AM-noon - Resolve the Armando and Amazon Connect overlap
items.detail: Armando’s 1:1 and the Amazon Connect daily standup occupy the same slot. Choose coverage before the block starts and use the standup only for issues that remain open after all 12 offices went live.

items.label: Noon-1:00 PM - Protect the blocked work hour
items.detail: Use the first protected block to close the highest-risk rollout or Product decision rather than extending the 11:30 AM collision.

items.label: 1:30-2:00 PM - Maria 1:1
items.detail: The agenda is portfolio roadblocks and next steps. Bring the taskset blocker, VAWA readiness check, and November 16 Production Compliance restart dependency into the conversation.

items.label: 3:00-5:00 PM - Prepare, then lead the weekly team meeting
items.detail: Keep the 3:00 PM focus hour for a decision-ready agenda. Use the 4:00 PM meeting to assign owners, remove roadblocks, and confirm which SMS, Product, and Amazon Connect follow-ups move into next week.

items.label: Lock coverage for the 11:30 AM collision
items.detail: Decide whether Armando’s 1:1 or the Amazon Connect standup needs Jean live, delegate the other, and preserve the noon work block for follow-through.

items.label: Confirm the SMS grooming and sprint plan
items.detail: Dolapo asked Jean directly whether the communicated plan is clear. Reconcile the Sprint 23 versus Sprint 25 sequence, require a complete user-story inventory by use case, resolve English and Spanish template discrepancies, and confirm Product, IT, architecture, and Marketing roles before grooming begins.

items.label: Close today’s Operations readiness decisions
items.detail: Confirm whether the taskset blocker changes the RFE or Expansion path, capture the VAWA standalone readiness outcome, and decide whether the November 16 Production Compliance restart can proceed after leadership review.

items.label: Review and sign the fake help-desk security alert
items.detail: Rippling is waiting for Jean’s signature on the urgent law-firm phishing and fake help-desk notice. Complete the acknowledgment so the security communication is closed.

items.label: Gustavo is out today
items.detail: He returns Friday. Account for his absence if the BD portfolio review needs input or follow-through from him.

items.label: 11:00 AM-noon - Laura 1:1 and Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Use Laura’s 1:1 to confirm the SMS story and template plan, then carry only unresolved rollout risks into the standup.

items.label: Noon-1:00 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Keep the hour available for decisions or deliverables that emerge from the morning conversations.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - Management, executive status, and IT pipeline stack
items.detail: EPMO Management leads into the executive project slide update and the EPMO/IT pipeline sync. Prepare priority, UAT, and intake changes before the sequence starts.
